methods.name: U-Net and ResU-Net DL models
methods.summary: The authors implemented U-Net and ResU-Net deep learning models using Google Earth Engine modules and Python scripts on Google Colaboratory. The models use change detection-based input layers (NDVI difference, spectral angle, PC-4 band) and slope to produce per-pixel landslide probability maps.
methods.verbatim: We have used them as input layers to the U-Net and ResU-Net DL models in Python script on Google Colaboratory.

reproducibility_assessment: The landslide inventory and input datasets are mentioned without links, and the custom code used for the U-Net and ResU-Net models lacks a repository or persistent link.
